_about: The 503 a route answers when it stops waiting for its solve (app/main.py solver_timeout_handler, app/exceptions.SolverTimeoutError). Read by the engine's tests (tests/test_timing.py) AND by the API's (src/optimization/optimization-proxy.service.spec.ts): the gateway turns this body into ENGINE_TIMED_OUT by the code, or by the sentence for an engine older than the code, and two copies of a sentence in two languages is how a rewording gave every school 'The AI engine returned an error.' again. Change a sentence here and both suites say so.
_stage: What the generation route's 503 adds when the solve it gave up on was in a step (omgång 13, M2; app/solver/stage_clock.py): the step, the seconds in it and the seconds since the request came in, flat numbers beside the route and the ceiling. The gateway carries them to the page as the run's error params (ENGINE_TIMED_OUT). Absent from the other routes' bodies and from a 503 whose solve had closed its last step, and from an engine older than the field.
